name: vite-fullstack-template
description: Template for fast full stack development

scripts.build: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n CLIENT,SERVER -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter client build" "pnpm --filter server build"
scripts.tsc: pnpm --filter client tsc && pnpm --filter server tsc
scripts.test: pnpm --filter client test && pnpm --filter server test
